from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
release = json.loads((root / 'archive/deployment.json').read_text())['releasedCommit']
with TemporaryDirectory(dir=root, prefix='.retro.') as scratch:
    repo = Path(scratch) / 'repo'
    subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--quiet', str(root / 'archive/desk.bundle'), str(repo)], check=True)
    def git(*args):
        return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), *args], text=True)
    print(git('log', '--all', '--graph', '--decorate', '--format=%h %p %s'))
    for ref in (release, 'recorded-fix', 'HEAD'):
        print(git('show', '-s', '--format=%H %P %aI %cI %s', ref))
        print(git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', ref))
        print(git('show', f'{ref}:desk.mjs'))
    print(git('show', '--format=short', 'recorded-fix'))
    print(git('diff', release, 'HEAD'))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
archive = root / 'archive'
def hashes():
    return {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in archive.iterdir()}
before = hashes()
release = json.loads((archive / 'deployment.json').read_text())['releasedCommit']
sample = (archive / 'sample.json').read_bytes()
field = json.loads((archive / 'field-observation.json').read_text())
with TemporaryDirectory(dir=root, prefix='.retro.') as scratch:
    tmp = Path(scratch)
    repo = tmp / 'repo'
    subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--quiet', str(archive / 'desk.bundle'), str(repo)], check=True)
    for ref in (release, 'recorded-fix', 'HEAD'):
        revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'rev-parse', ref], text=True).strip()
        (tmp / 'desk.mjs').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'show', f'{ref}:desk.mjs']))
        (tmp / 'sample.json').write_bytes(sample)
        def run(*args):
            return subprocess.run(['node', 'desk.mjs', 'sample.json', *args], cwd=tmp, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
        initial = json.loads(run('list'))
        mark = run('mark', 'D7')
        saved = json.loads((tmp / 'sample.json').read_text())
        reopened = json.loads(run('list'))
        print(revision, 'initial=',initial, 'mark=',mark, 'disk=',saved,'reopened=',reopened)
        if ref == release:
            assert saved == field['afterWriter']
            assert mark == field['commandsInSeparateProcesses'][0]['stdout'].strip()
            assert reopened == json.loads(field['commandsInSeparateProcesses'][1]['stdout'])
        if ref == 'recorded-fix':
            assert initial == ['D8'] and reopened == ['D7', 'D8']
        if ref == 'HEAD':
            assert [row['flagged'] for row in saved] == [True, False] and reopened == []
            (tmp / 'sample.json').write_text(json.dumps([{'code': 'Q', 'title': 'Legacy', 'quiet': True}]))
            assert json.loads(run('list')) == ['Q']
            print('Synthetic quiet=true card is read as marked by maintenance.')
assert hashes() == before
print('Archive hashes unchanged.')
PY"
